title: nbn service fault - Lochinvar South, NSW
current_summary:
The fault affected an internet service in Lochinvar South, NSW. Service was restored at 3:54 pm AEDT on 15 November 2026.

nbn has restored the service by reconfiguring its network. If your service has not reconnected on its own, restart your Wi-Fi router and nbn Connection Box (if you have one).

nbn is investigating an alarm on a cell at a Fixed Wireless tower that has caused a loss of service. If the issue is unable to be corrected remotely, a field technician will be sent to the site to perform investigations. Updates will be provided as more information, or an ETA, becomes available.

Resolution: 3rd party network provider reconfigured network to restore wireless service

Services in your area have been restored following an unexpected network issue. If your service has not reconnected automatically, try restarting your Wi-Fi router and nbn Connection Box (if you have one).
